book.name: 1 TIMOTEO
book.title: 1 TIMOTEO Timoteo qui Pablonen raanni joi

content: Nincacointi ta nea joi qui. Pastorocatsihquibo ta siri tee queenihqui.

Pastorobo janon nescapahbo jonibo caishue. Jahua hahqui yohuanti yama. Huesti haiboyahpa. Tiromati qui hinamehyamahi. Hahri coirametai honan. Sirijaquin shinanax yohuannica. Jahuen xoboho nocotaibo jato sirijaquin bihnica. Papan joi nincamati shinanya.
Pahenyamahi. Joi coshin yohuanaima. Sinayamahi. Join bahchinanti shinanyamahi. Coriqui bihmisma.
Jahuen xoboho jihuetaibo sirijaquin jihuemanicah. Jaan yohihah jahuen baquebaan joi bichinxonma nincacai.
Jahuen baquebo jihuemati honanyamaxon ta jenquetsahaxonbi jaan Papan caisaibo nincamatimahiqui.

Rahma Papa qui hinamehtipibo ta pastorotimahiqui. Hea ta hen hashoan shinanya qui hih jan jamis, paramehtax. Jascani copi ta Papan tiroma yoshin casticanyaxihquiqui. Jascapa tiroma shinan bihmis hihxon behnabo pastoromayamahue.
Nincacoinyamahibo siripi hahqui yohuanai nincaxon pari pastoromahue. Tiromahi hahqui yohuanaiboya Satanasnen jaa tiroma shinan hinanmis.
Pastorobaan yanapannicahbo rihbi ta shinanya jonibo hihtihiqui. Yohuanresaima. Pahenyosma. Coriqui bihmisma.
Papan yohinihxonma bi rahma nincamahi joi ta Criston joi qui. Jaa joi ta jaton jointinin yanapannicahbaan bihtihiqui, ponte jihueti honanax jascabihi sca jihueti.
Jato tanatahhue. Siribohi honanscaxon jato caishue, yanapannicahbo hihnon hihxon.
Jaton haibobo rihbi ta shinanya hihtihiqui. Tsoa qui bi yohuanyamahi. Pahenyosma. Shinanquin sirijaxon hahcai.
Yanapannica cahen huesti haiboyahpa. Jaton baquebo, jaton xobon jihuetaibo sirijaquin jato jihuemaquin.
Sirijaquin yanapanaiboya ta jato qui siripi yohuancantihiqui. Sirijaquin yanapanax sca ta Jesucriston joi yohiti qui hihtimahtimahi qui.
Mihqui histon cacatsihxon bi tah hen huishaxon mia yohihi.

Hea basi sca jaiya tah min honantihi, Papan baquebo jenquetsahpi jihuetihiquin hihxon. Papan baquebo rahsi ta jan caisaibo qui, jihuenicaxon jan caisai. Jaabo ta Criston joi coin bihnicahbo qui, Cristo qui hihcoini yohuanaibo.
Papan yohinihxonma bi rahma noque nincamahi joi ta hahan rahteti qui, tsoan nincanihma joi. Jasca coin tah qui.

content.text: Yorayahpahax ta Cristo cainnishqui. Ponte shinanya jan hihqui ta Dios Yoshiman sca noque jismanishqui. Jan main nichi ta Papan yonotibaan jisnishqui. Judiomabo sca ta jahuen joi yohicaniqui jahuen jihuetahbaan. Nai namanxon ta nincacoincaniqui. Naihohxon sca ta Papan bihinihninishqui.
